accuracy_to_source_and_ruling.note: All 57 positions name the Gulf «Арабский залив» in the case the sentence requires, including the second mention in ru-11 and ru-21. ru-30/ru-38 follow the Arabic «دول الخليج العربي» exactly. One point off for ru-23 «по всему Арабскому заливу»: the reading is regional («throughout the Gulf»). The water-body name is the ruling's form and stays.

naturalness.note: The grammar is clean throughout: case, agreement and word order. «Арабский залив» is less familiar to a Russian reader than «Персидский залив», and the blind reader paid that cost. It is the inherent cost of O-GULF, it is not a defect of this proposal, and the reader still identified the sea correctly from the page context. «страны Арабского залива» repeated about 40 times reads as a set phrase, which is acceptable for a glossary term.

consistency.note: One pattern everywhere: «Арабский залив», «регион Арабского залива», «побережье Арабского залива» and «страны Арабского залива». The visa-guide table row (ru-45, ru-54) and the FAQ quotation of that row (ru-53) are word-for-word identical, as calibration ruling 10 requires.

constraint_compliance.note: Scope is narrow: only the Gulf phrase changed, and in ru-30/ru-38 the redundant «арабских» was dropped. No new ASCII quotes, no newlines, no «Персидск», and no bare «Залив». Links and «ёлочки» are unchanged. The Эль-Халидж street name and organisation names were left alone.

rulings.title: Mitigation of the unfamiliar name «Арабский залив»
rulings.ruling: No locator is added. The unfamiliarity is the inherent cost of the owner ruling O-GULF and is accepted, as were the name collisions in ru P8 and tr Kare. The mitigation is already on the pages. Most first mentions place the sea («на побережье Арабского залива к востоку от Аль-Ахсы», «на востоке Саудовской Аравии»), every page sits inside an Al-Ahsa / Saudi Arabia frame, and the blind reader located the sea correctly from that context alone. A locator such as «у восточного побережья Саудовской Аравии» would add words the source does not carry, at about 20 first mentions, which breaks the narrow mandate («كل كلمة أخرى تبقى حرفياً») without a reader-comprehension failure to justify it. «Персидский» is never used as a gloss, even in parentheses.
rulings.precedent: ru P8 (collision accepted; legitimate mitigation is the presence of the name and its context, not a respelling); tr Kare / Busalih (collisions accepted as inherent); BRIEF O-GULF (no added facts)

rulings.title: ru-30 / ru-38: dropping «арабских» before «страны Арабского залива»
rulings.ruling: Approved. The Arabic source of ru-38 says «دول الخليج العربي» («states of the Arabian Gulf»). The English «Arab Gulf states» carries «Arab» because it stands for «العربي», which «Арабского» now renders. «арабских странах Арабского залива» would double the epithet. The same reasoning applies to ru-30 (en «Arab Gulf states»).
rulings.precedent: BRIEF scope: grammar the Gulf phrase forces; termbase #627

rulings.title: ru-39: «экономическое соглашение стран Арабского залива»
rulings.ruling: Approved as proposed. The sources say «الاتفاقية الاقتصادية الخليجية» / «the Gulf economic agreement», a descriptive reference and not an official title, so the qualifier applies. Naming the actual GCC agreement would add a fact. The reader's remark that the agreement is unnamed is a source-content matter and is out of scope.
rulings.precedent: BRIEF exceptions (official organisation names only); no-invention rule

rulings.title: visa-guide: GCC residents rendered «страны Арабского залива»
rulings.ruling: Keep «стран(ы) Арабского залива» with the qualifier (ru-44 to ru-54). Do not introduce «государства — члены ССАГПЗ» or the organisation's full name. The official Russian title is «Совет сотрудничества арабских государств Персидского залива» (termbase #627), and the abbreviation ССАГПЗ expands to it, so either would bring «Персидского» onto the page against O-GULF. The Russian line has never used the organisation name here: the published glossary term for GCC countries is the generic phrase. Swapping in an organisation name would widen the mandate. The generic phrase with «Арабского» covers the same six states, and the blind reader read it as the GCC. The route name stays identical in the table row and in the FAQ quotation.
rulings.precedent: termbase #627 and calibration ruling 10; BRIEF «never Персидский»; narrow mandate

rulings.title: «Дорога Эль-Халидж» (Sinyar page)
rulings.ruling: Stays. It is a street proper name and an explicit BRIEF exception. Translating it («дорога Залива» / «дорога Арабского залива») would invent a name the street does not carry. The reader's link between «Халидж» and the Gulf is not needed for navigation.
rulings.precedent: BRIEF exceptions; termbase #242 (no «дорога Залива»); ru-attr-11 rulings

rulings.title: ru-23 «по всему Арабскому заливу» and ru-24 «в Арабский залив»
rulings.ruling: Kept. Both carry the regional sense the previous «по всему Заливу» / «в Залив» carried, and the sources (blog en/ar) refer to the Gulf as a region in the same way. Adding «региону» would go beyond the forced grammar.
rulings.precedent: narrow mandate; BRIEF scope covers the region under the same name

termbase_notes.append: OWNER 2026-10-27 (O-GULF, gulf-unify-1027) supersedes the founding P5 decision: ru = «Арабский залив» (lower-case «залив» inside the name) / «регион Арабского залива» / «побережье Арабского залива»; склоняется: Арабского залива, Арабскому заливу, в Арабский залив, в Арабском заливе. Bare «Залив» is retired; «Персидский залив» remains forbidden, also as a gloss. A repeated mention in the same passage carries the epithet. Mitigation for unfamiliarity: none added. The page context (east of Al-Ahsa / east of Saudi Arabia) is the locator, and the cost is accepted as inherent (stage 7 R1, precedent P8).

2026-10-27 (O-GULF): ru = «страны Арабского залива» (резиденты стран Арабского залива, в странах Арабского залива). «государства — члены ССАГПЗ» and the full organisation title are not used: both expand to «...Персидского залива» against O-GULF. The en «Arab Gulf states» = ar «دول الخليج العربي» ⇒ «страны Арабского залива» without an extra «арабских» (stage 7 R2). The visa route name «Резиденты стран Арабского залива» is identical in the table row and the FAQ quotation (calibration ruling 10).
2026-10-27: unchanged under O-GULF. A street proper name is a BRIEF exception, so no «дорога Арабского залива» (stage 7 R5).
2026-10-27: superlative now «один из крупнейших водоёмов в регионе Арабского залива» (O-GULF).
